messages:
jenna: @mike-se acme POC can't see trace_id in Datadog after they export logs from our hosted drain. In Console traces look fine, but exported log lines show "trace_id": null. any quick ideas?

mike-se: do we have a sample exported log line and their forwarder config? first suspicion: field mapping / normalizer dropping the key. also check sampling policy.

raj-sre: common culprit is header passthrough or JSON reformatting. if the app sets traceparent/trace-id but the proxy doesn't forward it, the drain won't have it. nginx snippet we ask customers to verify:
```
proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent;
proxy_set_header x-request-id $request_id;
```
Also ensure our log-normalizer isn't flattening/removing nested fields.

mike-se: pls paste one exported line (you can redact PII). also include the datadog-forwarder config (or splunk plugin) so I can check mapping.

acme-poc: pasted sample below (redacted):
{"ts":"2025-06-10T15:00:01Z","msg":"request completed","trace_id":null,"request_id":"req-123","user":"redacted"}

jenna: customer also hit procurement question — what would Dedicated cost for a 2-week stress run? need a ballpark for finance.

tess-ac: ballpark: small Dedicated pool (2-3 gpus) we can price ~ $5k/week. we can do a POC discount or credits for customers that sign a T&C. i'll follow up in DM with the template and invoice cadence.

mike-se: troubleshooting checklist (short):
1) verify trace exists in service logs before our drain
2) ensure drain preserves JSON keys (no flattening)
3) exporter mapping: Datadog prefers dd.trace_id or trace_id depending on pipeline
4) confirm sampler isn't dropping traces at edge
5) if using proxy, forward traceparent / x-trace-id headers

raj-sre: FYI we had a small config change earlier that touched the normalizer mapping. @deploy-bot restarted the drain at ~15:10 — worth checking post-redeploy.

deploy-bot: log-drain redeploy triggered by CI at 1715001800 — rollout completed :white_check_mark:

acme-poc: after the redeploy I re-ran exports — trace_id now populated: {"ts":"2025-06-10T15:12:05Z","trace_id":"0x7a2b9","request_id":"req-124"} :tada:

jenna: great, thank you. i'll mark the POC issue as resolved and send the Dedicated estimate.

mike-se: i'll add a short note to the onboarding checklist to include header passthrough and dd.trace_id mapping so this doesn't surprise future customers.

tess-ac: also following up on the KMS question in the security questionnaire — we'll need to confirm customer-managed keys for exports. i'll loop security once i have the procurement contact.

jenna: awesome, closing this thread. :thumbsup:
